Thanks Marcus / Samira —

We can usually approve Net30 for strategic partners; a few operational checks first:

1) Confirmed paperwork: W-9, ACH form, and COI look fine from a quick scan. We'll ingest these into the vendor portal. Please confirm the legal entity name on the W-9 matches the remit name on invoices.

2) PO workflow: for the initial pilot, issue a manual PO (finance will create a one-off PO and route to AP). Please have BlueLens populate the PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx and return to David (cc'd). David will create the PO in the system and assign the vendor code.

3) Credit / cashflow: to move from Net45->Net30 we need a one-month lookback on expected invoice volume and payment cadence. Samira, could you send an expected invoice run-rate for the next 90 days (approx $ by month) and confirm whether invoices will be consolidated weekly or submitted per project? That helps us size working capital impact.

4) Early-pay pilot: Finance is open to a short 3-invoice early-pay pilot via our EarlyPay program. We need the EarlyPay_Application.pdf completed and signed; finance will calculate the discount using our standard dynamic discount matrix. If BlueLens accepts the calculated discount, we can cut payment in 7–14 days for those invoices.

Next steps:
- Samira: return the completed PO template + expected invoice run-rate + completed EarlyPay application (if interested).
- David: once submitted, I'll route for Net30 approval and set up the manual PO.

I'll own the approval thread and keep Marcus updated.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx (please return), EarlyPay_Application.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@bluelens.io>

See attached: PO_Template_Redwood_filled.xlsx (we put remit name as BlueLens Analytics, Inc. to match W-9) and a short forecast for next 90 days (est. $48k / $62k / $75k). A few clarifications:
- We will submit weekly consolidated invoices on Fridays.
- For the EarlyPay pilot we prefer 14-day payment with a 1.25% discount — but we understand Redwood will calculate the official rate.

Please confirm the manual PO number once it's been created and a vendor code so we can add it to our billing system.

Best,

Samira —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the forecast and completed forms. I've created a manual PO for your account: PO# RWD-2028-4517. Vendor code: V-98731. We ingested the W-9 and ACH into the vendor portal; please allow 24–48 hours for the portal record to propagate.

Net30 approval: Kimberly has signed off contingent on the submitted forecast — Net45 -> Net30 is approved for the account effective on the first invoice after PO activation.

Welcome aboard — reach out if you see any missing fields on the PO or if you'd like us to auto-route invoices to a dedicated mailbox (we recommend ap+bluelens@redwood.com).
